institution.zh: 國立陽明交通大學　資訊工程學系
institution.en: Department of Computer Science, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

statement.zh: 我們讓大型模型在資源有限的硬體上跑得動。從 KV-Cache 壓縮、低秩分解、推測解碼到稀疏加速器設計，處理的是同一件事：把模型的計算與記憶體需求，壓到裝置真正負擔得起的範圍。
statement.en: We make large models run on hardware that cannot afford them. KV-cache compression, low-rank projection, speculative decoding, sparse accelerator design — all of it works on one problem: bringing a model's compute and memory down to what a device can actually carry.

address.zh: 新竹市東區大學路 1001 號

title.zh: 教授　實驗室主持人

zh: 吳凱強的研究處理同一個落差：模型的能力成長得比硬體快。實驗室的工作是把這個落差拆成可以動手的問題——一個 KV-Cache 到底需要多少記憶體、一次解碼能不能少跑幾層、加速器上的稀疏結構要長成什麼樣子，硬體才真的省得到時間。
近年的主軸是大型語言模型的推論效率：以低秩投影壓縮 KV-Cache（Palu, ICLR 2025）、以替代草稿模型加速 offloaded 推論的推測解碼（NeurIPS 2025），以及視覺模型的逐層 N:M 稀疏與低秩架構搜尋（ELSA、FLORA）。這條線延續實驗室較早的硬體路線：可分解 MAC 的收縮陣列、FPGA 上的稀疏張量單元，以及加速器的容錯設計。
實驗室與康乃爾大學、德州大學奧斯汀分校等研究群合作。畢業生多進入台灣半導體與 EDA 產業，也有人繼續攻讀博士。
en: Kai-Chiang Wu's work addresses one gap: models grow more capable faster than hardware grows able to run them. The lab breaks that gap into things you can act on — how much memory a KV-cache really needs, whether a decoding step can skip layers, and which sparsity structures let an accelerator save time rather than only save parameters.

The current focus is inference efficiency for large language models: compressing the KV-cache with low-rank projection (Palu, ICLR 2025), speculative decoding with substitute drafters for offloaded inference (NeurIPS 2025), and layer-wise N:M sparsity and low-rank architecture search for vision models (ELSA, FLORA). It continues the lab's longer line of hardware work: systolic arrays built on decomposable MACs, sparse tensor units for FPGAs, and fault mitigation for accelerators.
The lab collaborates with groups at Cornell and UT Austin. Graduates go mostly into Taiwan's semiconductor and EDA industry, and several have continued to doctoral study abroad.

name.zh: 大型語言模型推論加速

summary.zh: 長文本生成時，KV-Cache 與逐步解碼是兩個主要瓶頸。我們以低秩投影壓縮快取、以替代草稿模型做推測解碼，目標是在不重新訓練、不改變輸出的前提下把延遲降下來。
summary.en: In long-context generation the KV-cache and the decoding loop are the bottlenecks. We compress the cache with low-rank projection and speculate with substitute drafters, cutting latency without retraining and without changing what the model outputs.

summary.zh: 量化、低秩分解與 N:M 稀疏各能省下多少，取決於它們落在哪一層。我們把它當成逐層的配置問題：讓壓縮的代價花在模型最承受得起的地方。
summary.en: How much quantisation, low-rank decomposition and N:M sparsity save depends on which layer they land in. We treat it as a per-layer allocation problem: spend the error budget where the model can absorb it.

summary.zh: 在記憶體受限的裝置上做訓練或微調，記憶體重算與架構搜尋必須一起設計。我們研究這兩者的取捨，以及模型部署之後如何維持。
summary.en: Training or fine-tuning on a memory-bound device means rematerialisation and architecture search have to be designed together. We study that trade-off, and what keeps a model working after deployment.

zh: 實驗室招收博士班、碩士班與大學部專題生，研究方向涵蓋大型語言模型的推論效率與模型壓縮。
有興趣的同學請來信與主持人聯絡，並簡述你的背景與想投入的方向。
en: The lab takes doctoral students, master's students and undergraduate project students. The work spans inference efficiency for large language models and model compression.
If you are interested, write to the PI with a short description of your background and the direction you would like to work in.
